influences.name: Ken Burns
influences.context: I guess I had just watched Ken Burns' Jack Johnson documentary.

influences.name: Lou Reed
influences.context: Lou Reed died when I was probably about three-quarters of the way through writing it. I'm not sure how big of an influence that was, but it was part of it. The song was about a period that's fascinating because of guys like Lou Reed — the early '70s and the late '60s with the Velvet Underground and Andy Warhol in New York.
